1.hint: Connect to your lab server over SSH as ec2-user.

2.hint: sudo su - - become root to inspect system files.

4.hint: cat the pgdg-redhat-all.repo file - the PGDG repo definition.

5.hint: dnf repolist -v | grep -i pgdg - the enabled PGDG repos.

6.hint: dnf list installed | grep postgres - the 4 installed packages.

8.hint: rpm -ql postgresql16-server | head -30 - files the package installed.

9.hint: rpm -ql postgresql16-server | grep bin - the server binaries.

10.hint: rpm -ql postgresql16 | grep bin - the client binaries.

14.hint: count the .control files - number of extensions.

15.hint: systemctl cat postgresql-16 - the service unit + your override.

16.hint: ls the drop-in dir - the override directory.

19.hint: alternatives --display pgsql-psql - how psql is managed.

22.hint: ls -la /etc/alternatives/pgsql-psql - the next link in the chain.
